mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the heart’s own vessels was most worthwhile: the planned cutaway distinguishes the muscle’s supply from blood in the chambers and explains why the pump needs its own supply.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the systemic network was relatively thin on its own: the picture description named two loops but did not detail their flow directions until blood was added.

surprise.text: The separate coronary supply stood out: blood in the chambers cannot by itself feed all the thick heart muscle.

arbitrary.text: No action lacked a clear overall purpose, although the coronary sinus was named without explanation. Most choices were the only offered combination, so their compatibility was supplied rather than discovered.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how the circulation connects to the larger body, though the mostly single-option sequence offered limited meaningful choice.
